strictInvariant.en: DataLoader streaming throughput must match GPU processing capacity without degrading simulation mesh accuracy.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: DataLoader 串流吞吐量必須滿足 GPU 運算速率，且不得降低數值模擬網格精度。

en: Rewriting the OpenFOAM C++ solver core
Adding more GPU hardware to compensate for host I/O stalls
zh-TW: 重寫 OpenFOAM C++ 求解器核心

failureConditions.en: If host memory bandwidth saturates or disk read latency increases, the pipeline uses cached chunk prefetching to prevent GPU idling.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 若主機記憶體頻寬飽和或磁碟讀取延遲增加，管線啟用快取分塊預取機制，防止 GPU 閒置。

challenger.en: Why not simply add more GPU memory or rent a larger cluster to increase training throughput?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼不直接擴充 GPU 記憶體或租用更大規模的叢集來提高訓練吞吐量？

defense.en: Adding more compute GPUs does not solve a host CPU data loading bottleneck. It only increases GPU idle time. By isolating format deserialization bottlenecks and building an asynchronous pipeline, we achieved ~10× throughput on existing hardware with no additional hardware cost.
defense.zh-TW: 增加 GPU 算力無法解決主機端的資料載入瓶頸，只會增加 GPU 閒置時間。透過找出格式反序列化瓶頸並建立非同步管線，我們在既有硬體上達成約 10 倍訓練吞吐量提升，不需要額外採購硬體。

challenger.en: How did you structure the workflow when using AI code assistance for loader refactoring?
challenger.zh-TW: 在使用 AI 工具輔助改寫資料載入器時，你如何規劃架構並確保程式碼品質？

defense.en: As Senior AI Engineer, I profiled the workload to diagnose bottlenecks, specified asynchronous prefetching and caching architectures, and reviewed generated code line by line to verify numerical accuracy and interface stability.
defense.zh-TW: 我主導系統效能分析以找出瓶頸，制定非同步預取與快取架構規格，並逐行審查生成的程式碼，確保數值精度與介面穩定性。
